name: com.ethar.debugdrawingbbox
description: World-space debug drawing for vision detection events: renders detection bounding boxes (outline, centre marker and confidence label) through the capture-time camera pose. Ships two switchable render modules — Ephemeral (pose-frozen outline boxes redrawn per payload, the default) and Anchored (persistent depth-anchored tags via Meta environment depth, scene-mesh raycast or fixed-distance fallback) — plus the URP/XR-safe unlit material factory and an editor drawing test harness.
